description: This file defines a class 'MemorizingFile' that wraps a file object to memorize lines read by the readline method, primarily used for buffering and testing purposes.

classes.name: MemorizingFile
classes.description: A class that wraps a file object to memorize lines read by readline, with a maximum limit on memorized lines.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the MemorizingFile with a file object and optional maximum number of lines to memorize.

methods.name: __getattribute__
methods.description: Custom attribute access to delegate to the wrapped file object for attributes not explicitly handled.

methods.name: readline
methods.description: Reads a line from the file, memorizes it, and handles buffering if size is specified.

methods.name: get_memorized_lines
methods.description: Returns the list of lines that have been memorized so far.

search-terms: wraps a file and memorizes lines
